### Rampage — *Fallout: Equestria: Project Horizons*

**Who she is:** Rampage is **Arloste**, a fearsome, near-unkillable earth-pony Reaper from Hoofington who becomes one of Blackjack’s major companions. **Spoiler:** she was originally **Peppermint (“Minty”)**, Twist’s daughter. The Phoenix Talisman preserves her life but also carries other souls and personalities; these are **not disguises**. She is a character in **Somber’s *Project Horizons* fanfiction continuity**, not a character from Hasbro’s animated *Friendship Is Magic*.

**Spot her:** Off-white/cream coat with striking **red zebra-like stripes**, pink eyes, red mane and braided tail, **razor wire in her tail**, immense bladed silver armor, a spiked helmet with a false horn, and metal **hoofclaws**. She is an earth pony, not a zebra. Her cutie mark can change with the personality in control.

**Names and appearances:** **Peppermint** is her birth name; **Arloste** was a name given to her later by Bonesaw and Scalpel. She adopted **Rampage** from another Reaper she defeated; it is not an unrelated alter ego. The talisman can express the memories/personalities of **Twist, Shujaa, Razorwire, Nurse Candy** and others. She first appears in **chapter 14, “Strength,”** and her origins become clearer in **chapter 70, “Calm.”** Sources: [Somber’s chapter 14](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/14), [chapter 70](https://fimfetch.net/story/208056/fallout-equestria-project-horizons/71), and [Fallout: Equestria Wiki’s Rampage profile](https://falloutequestria.fandom.com/wiki/Rampage_(Project_Horizons)).

**Speaking/voice:** She speaks extensively in the written story. **No official Hasbro screen voice or actor** is established. A *fan animation*, *Do Not Shoot Blackjack!*, specifically credits **Brainiac** for Rampage’s voice—not an official casting credit. [Animator’s credit](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3412623300).
